annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage as an MLM-style smart-contract opportunity where participation requires joining payments and earnings are tied to recruiting a network. The description promises "100%" and "Unlimited" earning, offers payment per referral, and asks for 20 networkers, while the frames show commission payout structures and entry payments in ETH and TRX. These combined recruitment-dependent earning claims and paid-entry instructions constitute an active solicitation rather than neutral blockchain education.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promotion explicitly links income to recruiting networkers and displays multi-level X3/X4 commission structures. The required entry payments and referral-dependent earning claims establish a recruitment and qualification relationship rather than an ordinary one-level referral promotion.
